input: Repot all succulents on the kitchen shelf

gold.taskDescription: Repot every succulent currently sitting on the kitchen shelf into new or larger containers.

questions.title: How many succulents are on the kitchen shelf?
questions.description: Establish the exact count of plants that need to be repotted.

questions.title: Are the current pots too small or damaged?
questions.description: Understand the reason for repotting to choose the right replacement pot size and type.

questions.title: Do you already have new pots and soil?
questions.description: Determine whether supplies need to be purchased before the task can begin.

questions.title: What type of soil mix do you prefer?
questions.description: Clarify whether a specific cactus or succulent mix is required or already on hand.

questions.title: Do the new pots need drainage holes?
questions.description: Confirm pot drainage requirements to avoid overwatering issues after repotting.

questions.title: When do you want this fully completed by?
questions.description: Set a deadline or target date to structure the repotting schedule around.

questions.title: Where will you do the repotting work itself?
questions.description: Identify the workspace so prep for mess, tools, and cleanup can be planned.
